title: Quantifying the Limits of Segmentation Foundation Models: Modeling Challenges in Segmenting Tree-Like and Low-Contrast Objects
mechanism: Interpretable tree-likeness and textural-separability metrics predict SAM / SAM2 / HQ-SAM failures; targeted fine-tuning did not remove the failure.
adaptation: Compute both metrics per crack component on val (7% of crack components are < 2% darker than surroundings); stratify FM-arm vs house errors; define benchmark strata by contrast.
min_experiment: CPU-only: per-tercile relR@2 for house vs best FM arm on val; report, no kill needed (analysis tool).
evidence: R: synthetic controlled experiments plus real datasets; correlation of SFM performance with both metrics.

alt_notes.adaptation: Compute both metrics per crack component on test and E1 and stratify benchmark results (7% of crack components are < 2% darker than surroundings).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Analysis only: stratified recall by separability bin for house vs FM arms.
